page.notes: The left column is blank. Arabic words (منى, شدّ, نم), the Hebrew line העורכים לגר שלחן והממלאים, and the Greek τῇ Μάνα are copied as they appear; their vowel points and exact letter forms are not fully clear at this scan resolution, so the Arabic and Hebrew readings are doubtful.
